name: StudentHub MKU
description: Official student portal for Mount Kenya University School of Law — events, marketplace, clubs, gallery, bulletins, and anonymous Vault.

institution.name: Mount Kenya University School of Law

features.name: Campus Events
features.description: Discover, RSVP, and register for moot courts, academic sessions, student forums, and networking events.

features.name: Student Marketplace
features.description: Buy, sell, and trade products and services around campus. Student merchants can manage their portfolios.

features.name: Clubs & Societies
features.description: Explore student guilds, advocacy groups, and special interest societies with detailed mini-sites.

features.name: Campus Gallery
features.description: Browse photographs, stories, and moments from MKU campus life organized by albums.

features.name: Official Bulletins
features.description: Read official campus releases, announcements, and communications from the administration.

features.name: The Vault
features.description: Submit anonymous feedback, complaints, ideas, and suggestions securely.

routes.title: Homepage
routes.description: Landing page with hero, bulletins, events preview, marketplace, and gallery.

routes.title: Events Calendar
routes.description: Browse and RSVP to campus events with category filters and search.

routes.title: Event Detail
routes.description: Event details with registration form, RSVP, and sharing.

routes.title: Clubs Directory
routes.description: Explore student societies with mini-sites, leadership, and activities.

routes.title: Campus Gallery
routes.description: Photo gallery with albums, lightbox, and admin upload.

routes.title: Marketplace
routes.description: Student marketplace with product listings, campaigns, and seller profiles.

routes.title: Seller Dashboard
routes.description: Vendor portfolio management with catalog, promotions, and image upload.

routes.title: Authentication
routes.description: Student sign-in and registration with Google and email.

routes.title: Admin Console
routes.description: Executive administration console for content, events, gallery, and users.

routes.title: Terms of Agreement
routes.description: Platform terms of agreement and merchant conduct standards.

routes.title: Privacy Policy
routes.description: Privacy policy and data protection guidelines.

endpoints.description: Send event registration confirmation email via Resend.
Send event reminder email to registered attendees.
Broadcast newsletter to subscribers via Resend.
Notify vendor of new marketplace lead.

tech_stack.frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4, Wouter, TanStack Query, Framer Motion
tech_stack.backend: Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Realtime Database), Vercel serverless functions
